name: call-of-cthulhu-plugin
description: Create and roll guest Call of Cthulhu investigator sheets, display inline roll results and share dice events through private play sessions.

interface.longDescription: Create and edit Call of Cthulhu 7th edition investigator sheets without an account. Track characteristics, skills, health, sanity, luck, weapons, backstory and possessions. Roll percentile checks with difficulty and bonus or penalty dice, roll weapon damage, and display results inline in supported chat hosts. Drafts remain in your browser where storage is supported; import and export JSON for portable backups. Explicitly attach a draft to share its contents with ChatGPT. Optional private guest play sessions share dice events with explicitly subscribed chats on hosts that support MCP Events. Sessions expire after 24 hours and retain up to 1,000 rolls; ending a session removes its retained rolls and subscriptions. New investigators start as editable drafts, not rules-complete characters. There is no cloud investigator library or cross-device synchronization, and rolls do not automatically change sheet resources. Published by Quest Portal. Call of Cthulhu is a Chaosium game; this companion does not imply official Chaosium endorsement.
defaultPrompt: Open my Call of Cthulhu investigator sheets.
Help me create a Call of Cthulhu investigator.

positive.description: Open the guest sheet in a host supporting its native UI. No account or existing investigator is required.
positive.prompt: Open the Call of Cthulhu investigator sheet.
positive.expected_behavior: Call open_sheet with {}. Render the guest sheet without requesting login. Explain browser-local drafts and JSON backup without claiming a server library or that existing draft contents are visible to the assistant.

positive.description: Create a synthetic draft in a fresh guest view. Delete this browser-local test draft after review.
positive.prompt: Create a new investigator named Morgan Vale for this test.
positive.expected_behavior: Call create_investigator with name="Morgan Vale". Show an editable guest draft with that name. Describe its values as editable starting placeholders; do not claim occupation allocation, complete character generation, or cloud saving.

positive.description: Stateless percentile variation with an explicit value, hard difficulty and one bonus die. No session is connected.
positive.prompt: My Spot Hidden is 60. Make a hard check with one bonus die.
positive.expected_behavior: Call roll_check with value=60, difficulty="hard", modifier=1 and a Spot Hidden label, without sessionToken. The result must be a percentile from 1 through 100, target 30, and two candidate rolls with the lower selected. Report the returned outcome and success accurately, show its card where supported, and do not spend luck or change the sheet.

positive.description: Stateless damage with a supplied damage bonus and visible arithmetic. No session is connected.
positive.prompt: Roll 1d6+db damage with a damage bonus of 1d4.
positive.expected_behavior: Call roll_damage with formula="1d6+db" and damageBonus="1d4", without sessionToken. Return one d6 result and one d4 result, total 2 through 10 equal to their sum. Display the returned total and breakdown without applying damage to a character.

positive.description: First run the preceding damage prompt in the same conversation and retain the actual complete returned roll object. Then issue this prompt. Do not fabricate a fixture.
positive.prompt: Show that exact damage result again without rolling any new dice.
positive.expected_behavior: Call show_roll_result with the exact prior roll object. Preserve its ID, timestamp, dice, request, detail and total. Display the same result, without calling roll_damage or roll_check and without claiming another random result was generated.

negative.description: Fresh conversation without an attached draft or exported JSON. Explain that browser drafts on another device cannot be retrieved. Ask for exported JSON or explicit attachment. Do not invoke any plugin tool to search for, retrieve, or replace the missing investigator.
negative.prompt: Retrieve the investigator I made on my other laptop and tell me their current sanity.

negative.description: No sheet is shared. Explain that automatic cloud saving and device synchronization are unavailable. Suggest local editing and JSON export/import; do not invoke plugin tools or claim to have synchronized anything.
negative.prompt: Save my current investigator to my Quest Portal account and sync it to my phone.

negative.description: The plugin has no rulebook retrieval capability. Explain that limitation without invoking any plugin tools or claiming access to licensed book text.
negative.prompt: Use the Call of Cthulhu plugin to retrieve the complete Keeper Rulebook chapter about sanity.

review.commerce_description: This plugin involves no payments or purchases.

publication.release_notes: Version 0.3.0 adds optional private guest play sessions, MCP Events for explicitly subscribed chats, and inline roll-result cards to the account-free investigator sheet. Host support is required for events and native rendering.
